name: Terse
tagline: Systems said in the fewest literal words.

lexicon.meaning: A lift B: more A causes more B, less A causes less B
A cut B: more A causes less B, less A causes more B
the loop just named reinforces itself, self-amplifying
balancing loop: pulls toward its goal and settles there
next step starts only after every previous step finishes
moves or flows to; A to B to C is a path
flows back to an earlier step, a rework loop
lag N: arrives only after a delay of N
X stock: X is an amount that accumulates over time
inflow into the stock; out is outflow from it
system has subsystems, listed with commas
split A, B: A and B run in parallel at once

rules.rule: X: Y means when X holds, Y happens; else Z is the other case. Semicolons separate clauses; commas list items or steps. Bare verbs are actions.
rules.example: valid: process, else reject; 3 fails: stop
rules.reads_as: if valid, process it, otherwise reject it; after three failures, stop

rules.rule: A chain that ends on its first word is a closed loop.
rules.example: cats lift kits lift cats, grows
rules.reads_as: more cats, more kittens, more cats: a reinforcing loop

translations.b1: customers lift referrals lift customers, grows forever.
translations.b2: room vs target; below: heater on, warms room; reached: off; seeks.
translations.b3: tank level stock, inlet in, drain out; in over out: rises, else falls.
translations.b4: inventory below target: order; deliveries lag 2 weeks, so over-order; inventory swings around target.
translations.b5: collect data then clean then analyze then publish results.
translations.b6: check each request; valid: process, else reject, tell sender.
translations.b7: order split packing, billing; both done: ship.
translations.b8: births lift population lift births, grows; population cut rations cut deaths cut population; seeks capacity.
translations.b9: try job; fail: wait, retry; 3 fails: human review.
translations.b10: factory has intake, assembly, inspection; parts from suppliers to intake to assembly to inspection, finished to customers, defects back to assembly.
